name: Podio
description: A customizable project management and CRM platform that allows teams to build their own work apps and automate workflows.

evidence.claim: The Podio API uses the OAuth2 protocol for authentication and supports multiple flows including server-side and app authentication.
The API is a complete programmable interface to all Podio functionality, as the entire frontend is built on it.
Podio provides an official MCP server for integration with AI agents like ChatGPT and Copilot Studio.
The API supports webhooks for building event-driven applications.
Official SDKs are available for PHP, .NET, Ruby, Java, Python, Android, and Objective-C.

notes: Podio provides a highly flexible API because the entire frontend is built on it. They offer multiple OAuth2 flows including a specific 'App authentication' flow for server-to-server scripts. An official MCP server is already available.
